<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Introduction</h1><a id="user-content-introduction" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Introduction" href="#introduction"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">WebGoat is a deliberately insecure web application maintained by <a href="http://www.owasp.org/" rel="nofollow">OWASP</a> designed to teach web
application security lessons.</p>
<p dir="auto">This program is a demonstration of common server-side application flaws. The
exercises are intended to be used by people to learn about application security and
penetration testing techniques.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>WARNING 1:</strong> <em>While running this program your machine will be extremely
vulnerable to attack. You should disconnect from the Internet while using
this program.</em>  WebGoat's default configuration binds to localhost to minimize
the exposure.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>WARNING 2:</strong> <em>This program is for educational purposes only. If you attempt
these techniques without authorization, you are very likely to get caught. If
you are caught engaging in unauthorized hacking, most companies will fire you.
Claiming that you were doing security research will not work as that is the
first thing that all hackers claim.</em></p>
<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="/WebGoat/WebGoat/blob/main/docs/images/webgoat.png"><img src="/WebGoat/WebGoat/raw/main/docs/images/webgoat.png" alt="WebGoat" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Installation instructions:</h1><a id="user-content-installation-instructions" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Installation instructions:" href="#installation-instructions"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">For more details check <a href="/WebGoat/WebGoat/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md">the Contribution guide</a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">1. Run using Docker</h2><a id="user-content-1-run-using-docker" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 1. Run using Docker" href="#1-run-using-docker"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Already have a browser and ZAP and/or Burp installed on your machine in this case you can run the WebGoat image directly using Docker.</p>
<p dir="auto">Every release is also published on <a href="https://hub.docker.com/r/webgoat/webgoat" rel="nofollow">DockerHub</a>.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 webgoat/webgoat"><pre>docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 webgoat/webgoat</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">For some lessons you need the container run in the same timezone. For this you can set the TZ environment variable.
E.g.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat"><pre>docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">If you want to use OWASP ZAP or another proxy, you can no longer use 127.0.0.1 or localhost. but
you can use custom host entries. For example:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="127.0.0.1 www.webgoat.local www.webwolf.local"><pre>127.0.0.1 www.webgoat.local www.webwolf.local</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Then you can run the container with:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e WEBGOAT_HOST=www.webgoat.local -e WEBWOLF_HOST=www.webwolf.local -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat"><pre>docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e WEBGOAT_HOST=www.webgoat.local -e WEBWOLF_HOST=www.webwolf.local -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Then visit <a href="http://www.webgoat.local:8080/WebGoat/" rel="nofollow">http://www.webgoat.local:8080/WebGoat/</a> and <a href="http://www.webwolf.local:9090/WebWolf/" rel="nofollow">http://www.webwolf.local:9090/WebWolf/</a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">2. Run using Docker with complete Linux Desktop</h2><a id="user-content-2-run-using-docker-with-complete-linux-desktop" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 2. Run using Docker with complete Linux Desktop" href="#2-run-using-docker-with-complete-linux-desktop"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Instead of installing tools locally we have a complete Docker image based on running a desktop in your browser. This way you only have to run a Docker image which will give you the best user experience.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 webgoat/webgoat-desktop"><pre>docker run -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 webgoat/webgoat-desktop</pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">3. Standalone</h2><a id="user-content-3-standalone" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 3. Standalone" href="#3-standalone"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Download the latest WebGoat release from <a href="https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/releases">https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/releases</a></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="export TZ=Europe/Amsterdam # or your timezone
java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar"><pre><span class="pl-k">export</span> TZ=Europe/Amsterdam <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> or your timezone</span>
java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Click the link in the log to start WebGoat.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">3.1 Running on a different port</h3><a id="user-content-31-running-on-a-different-port" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 3.1 Running on a different port" href="#31-running-on-a-different-port"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">If for some reason you want to run WebGoat on a different port, you can do so by adding the following parameter:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="java -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar --webgoat.port=8001 --webwolf.port=8002"><pre>java -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar --webgoat.port=8001 --webwolf.port=8002</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">For a full overview of all the parameters you can use, please check the [WebGoat properties file](webgoat-container/src/main/resources/application-{webgoat, webwolf}.properties).</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">4. Run from the sources</h2><a id="user-content-4-run-from-the-sources" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 4. Run from the sources" href="#4-run-from-the-sources"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Prerequisites:</h3><a id="user-content-prerequisites" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Prerequisites:" href="#prerequisites"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Java 25</li>
<li>Your favorite IDE</li>
<li>Git, or Git support in your IDE</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Open a command shell/window:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="git clone git@github.com:WebGoat/WebGoat.git"><pre>git clone git@github.com:WebGoat/WebGoat.git</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Now let's start by compiling the project.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="cd WebGoat
git checkout &lt;&lt;branch_name&gt;&gt;
# On Linux/Mac:
./mvnw clean install

# On Windows:
./mvnw.cmd clean install

# Using docker or podman, you can than build the container locally
docker build -f Dockerfile . -t webgoat/webgoat"><pre><span class="pl-c1">cd</span> WebGoat
git checkout <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-k">&lt;&lt;</span><span class="pl-k">branch_name&gt;&gt;</span></span>
<span class="pl-s"># On Linux/Mac:</span>
<span class="pl-s">./mvnw clean install</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s"># On Windows:</span>
<span class="pl-s">./mvnw.cmd clean install</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s"># Using docker or podman, you can than build the container locally</span>
<span class="pl-s">docker build -f Dockerfile . -t webgoat/webgoat</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Now we are ready to run the project. WebGoat is using Spring Boot.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="# On Linux/Mac:
./mvnw spring-boot:run
# On Windows:
./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> On Linux/Mac:</span>
./mvnw spring-boot:run
<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> On Windows:</span>
./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">... you should be running WebGoat on <a href="http://localhost:8080/WebGoat" rel="nofollow">http://localhost:8080/WebGoat</a> momentarily.</p>
<p dir="auto">Note: The above link will redirect you to login page if you are not logged in. LogIn/Create account to proceed.</p>
<p dir="auto">To change the IP address add the following variable to the <code>WebGoat/webgoat-container/src/main/resources/application.properties</code> file:</p>
<div class="snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="server.address=x.x.x.x"><pre class="notranslate"><code>server.address=x.x.x.x
</code></pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">4. Run with custom menu</h2><a id="user-content-4-run-with-custom-menu" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 4. Run with custom menu" href="#4-run-with-custom-menu"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">For specialist only. There is a way to set up WebGoat with a personalized menu. You can leave out some menu categories or individual lessons by setting certain environment variables.</p>
<p dir="auto">For instance running as a jar on a Linux/macOS it will look like this:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="export TZ=Europe/Amsterdam # or your timezone
export EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=&quot;CLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE&quot;
export EXCLUDE_LESSONS=&quot;SqlInjectionAdvanced,SqlInjectionMitigations&quot;
java -jar target/webgoat-2023.8-SNAPSHOT.jar"><pre><span class="pl-k">export</span> TZ=Europe/Amsterdam <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> or your timezone</span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>CLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> EXCLUDE_LESSONS=<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>SqlInjectionAdvanced,SqlInjectionMitigations<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
java -jar target/webgoat-2023.8-SNAPSHOT.jar</pre></div>

          Solution

          Remove the private IP address from the HTTP response body. For comments, use JSP/ASP/PHP comment instead of HTML/JavaScript comment which can be seen by client browsers.
      4. X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing (1)
        1. GET https://github.com/robots.txt
          Alert tags
          • CWE-693
          • OWASP_2021_A05
          • OWASP_2017_A06
          • POLICY_QA_STD =
          • POLICY_PENTEST =
          • SYSTEMIC
          Alert description

          The Anti-MIME-Sniffing header X-Content-Type-Options was not set to 'nosniff'. This allows older versions of Internet Explorer and Chrome to perform MIME-sniffing on the response body, potentially causing the response body to be interpreted and displayed as a content type other than the declared content type. Current (early 2014) and legacy versions of Firefox will use the declared content type (if one is set), rather than performing MIME-sniffing.
          Other info

          This issue still applies to error type pages (401, 403, 500, etc.) as those pages are often still affected by injection issues, in which case there is still concern for browsers sniffing pages away from their actual content type.

          At "High" threshold this scan rule will not alert on client or server error responses.

2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eWith great pleasure, we present you with a new release of WebGoat \u003cstrong\u003e2023.3\u003c/strong\u003e. Finally, it has been a while. This year\nstarts with a new release of WebGoat. This year we will undoubtedly release more often. From this release on, we began\nto use a new versioning scheme (\u003ca href=\"https://calver.org/#scheme\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003ehttps://calver.org/#scheme\u003c/a\u003e).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eA big thanks to René Zubcevic and Àngel Ollé Blázquez for keeping the project alive this last year, and hopefully, we\ncan make\nmany more releases this year.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch3 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eNew functionality\u003c/h3\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-new-functionality-2\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: New functionality\" href=\"#new-functionality-2\"\u003e\u003csvg class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eNew year's resolution(2022): major refactoring of WebGoat to simplify the setup and improve building times.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eMove away from multi-project setup:\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eThis has a huge performance benefit when building the application. Build time locally is now\n\u003ccode\u003eTotal time:  42.469 s\u003c/code\u003e (depends on your local machine of course)\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eNo longer add Maven dependencies in several places\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eH2 no longer needs to run as separate process, which solves the issue of WebWolf sharing and needing to configure\nthe correct database connection.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eMore explicit paths in html files to reference \u003ccode\u003eadoc\u003c/code\u003e files, less magic.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eIntegrate WebWolf in WebGoat, the setup was way too complicated and needed configuration which could lead to mistakes\nand a not working application. This also simplifies the Docker configuration as there is only 1 Docker image.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eAdd WebWolf button in WebGoat\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eMove all lessons into \u003ccode\u003esrc/main/resources\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eWebGoat selects a port dynamically when starting. It will still start of port 8080 it will try another port to ease\nthe user experience.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eWebGoat logs URL after startup: \u003ccode\u003ePlease browse to http://127.0.0.1:8080/WebGoat to get started...\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eSimplify \u003ccode\u003eDockerfile\u003c/code\u003e as we no longer need a script to start everything\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eMaven build now start WebGoat jar with Maven plugin to make sure we run against the latest build.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eAdded \u003ccode\u003eInitializable\u003c/code\u003e interface for a lesson, an assignment can implement this interface to set it up for a specific\nuser and to reset the assignment back to its original state when a reset lesson occurs. See \u003ccode\u003eBlindSendFileAssignment\u003c/code\u003e\nfor an example.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eIntegration tests now use the same user. This saves a lot of time as before every test used a different user which\ntriggered the Flyway migration to set up the database schema for the user. This migration took a lot of time.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eUpdated introduction lesson to WebWolf.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eAdded language switch for support for multiple languages.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eRemoved logic to start WebGoat on a random port when port \u003ccode\u003e8080\u003c/code\u003e is taken. We would loop until we found a free port.\nWe simplified this to just start on the specified port.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eAdd Google formatter for all our code, a PR now checks whether the code adheres to the standard.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eRenaming of all packages and folders.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ca href=\"https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1093\" data-hovercard-type=\"issue\" data-hovercard-url=\"/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1093/hovercard\"\u003e#1039 New OWASP Top 10\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003ca WebGoat release notes","","## Version 2025.3","","### 🐞 Bug fixes","","- Changed URLs imply other exclusion filters for ZAP (#2052)","- XSS lesson stage 12 (2 issues) (#1178)","","### 🔄 Technical tasks","","- bump docker/setup-qemu-action from 3.4.0 to 3.6.0 (#2049)","- bump docker/build-push-action from 6.14.0 to 6.15.0 (#2050)","","## Version 2025.2","","### 🐞 Bug fixes","","- Fix SQL advanced lesson assignment 5 (#2047)","","## Version 2025.1","","### 🚀 New functionality","","- Introduce Playwright for UI testing","- Refactoring of core code","","### 🐞 Bug fixes","","- Introduce assignment progress (#2043)","- Add test case for multiple users solving lessons (#2043)","- Register user while already logged in as other user. (#2042)","- Small updates and improvements in HTTP Basic lesson (#2024)","- Improve HTTP basics lesson","- Solve compiler warnings","- Cleanup attack result and builder","- Format all code according to SPDX","- Fixed one invalid solution about CSRF attack (#2010)","- Reset a lesson no longer removes all assignments","- Hint labels showing default text regardless of localization (#1965)","- Automatically solve XSS mitigation (#1957)","- Remove implicit context path guessing (#1956)","- JWT kid/jku lessons (#1949)","- Fix password reset lesson (#1941)","- Fix passing command line arguments (#1933)","- Use banners correctly","- Show boolean operators priority on `where` (#1902)","- Remove WebGoat session object (#1929)","- Reset form and quiz color on reset lesson (#1903)","- XSS lesson typo","- Copying file using `transferTo` sometimes fails. (#1862)","- Fix report card (#1845)","- Success if only Smith earn most salary (#1744)","- Update HttpBasics_plan.adoc - fix broken link to https://www.zaproxy.org/ (#1803)","- Move CSRF to A3 (#1776)","- Fix typo in SQLi blind case","- Use $ instead of jQuery which is undefined (#1736)","- Fix hidden links in MissingFunctionAC.html. GoogTech HackHuang","- Peter Potrowl","- cap-dev0x","- Benjamin Mouncer","- Jeong Rok Suh","- Rui Melo","- Vandeputte Brice","","## Version 2023.8","","### 🚀 New functionality","","- Consistent (#1687)","- Fix/state of software supply chain links (#1683)","- Fix WebWolf UI (#1686)","","### 🔄 Technical tasks","","- bump actions/setup-java from 3 to 4 (#1690)","- bump commons-io:commons-io from 2.14.0 to 2.15.1 (#1689)","- bump com.diffplug.spotless:spotless-maven-plugin (#1688)","","## Version 2023.5","","### New functionality","","- Implement JWT jku example (#1552)","- Java 21 initial support (#1622)","- improve MFAC lesson hint texts for a better user experience (#1424)","- upgrade to Spring Boot version 3 (#1477)","","### Bug fixes","","- typo in WebGoad.txt (#1667)","- search box moved and jwt encode/decode with little delay (#1664)","- skip validation for JWT (#1663)","- fixed issue in JWT test tool and added robot test (#1658)","- Password reset link test condition more strict and move all WebWolf links to /WebWolf  (#1645)","- fix servers id (#1619)","- potential NPE in the stored XSS assignment","- crypto basics broken links","- fixes the default change in trailing slash matching and address the affected assignments","- hint that was breaking the template, causing hints from different assignments to mix (#1424)","- HijackSession lesson template deprecated Tymeleaf attribute","- Fix NPE in IDOR lesson","- Add new assignment IT tests","- XSS mitigation","- Stored Cross-Site Scripting Lesson","- Add Assignment7 Tests","- Fix IDOR lesson","- remove steps from release script (#1509)","- robotframework fails due to updated dependencies (#1508)","- fix Java image inside Docker file The image now downloads the correct Java version based on the architecture.","- Fix typo of HijackSession_content0.adoc","- Restrict SSRF Regexes","- update challenge code - Flags are now wired through a Spring config - Introduced Flag class - Removed Flags from the","  FlagController","","## Version 2023.4","","### New functionality","","- [#1422 Add Docker Linux Desktop variant with all tools installed](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1422).","  Thanks to the [OWASP WrongSecrets project](https://owasp.org/www-project-wrongsecrets/) we now have a Docker Linux","  desktop image with all the tools installed. No need to install any tools locally only run the new Docker image. See","  README.md for details on how to start it.","- [#1411 JWT: looks that buy as Tom also works with alg:none](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1411).","","### Bug fixes","","- [#1410 WebWolf: JWT decode is broken](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1410).","- [#1396 password_reset return 500 Error](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1396).","- [#1379 Move XXE to A05:2021-Security Misconfiguration](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1379).","","## Version 2023.3","","With great pleasure, we present you with a new release of WebGoat **2023.3**. Finally, it has been a while. This year","starts with a new release of WebGoat. This year we will undoubtedly release more often. From this release on, we began","to use a new versioning scheme (https://calver.org/#scheme).","","A big thanks to René Zubcevic and Àngel Ollé Blázquez for keeping the project alive this last year, and hopefully, we","can make","many more releases this year.","","### New functionality","","- New year's resolution(2022): major refactoring of WebGoat to simplify the setup and improve building times.","- Move away from multi-project setup:","  * This has a huge performance benefit when building the application. Build time locally is now","    `Total time:  42.469 s` (depends on your local machine of course)","  * No longer add Maven dependencies in several places","  * H2 no longer needs to run as separate process, which solves the issue of WebWolf sharing and needing to configure","    the correct database connection.","- More explicit paths in html files to reference `adoc` files, less magic.","- Integrate WebWolf in WebGoat, the setup was way too complicated and needed configuration which could lead to mistakes","  and a not working application. This also simplifies the Docker configuration as there is only 1 Docker image.","- Add WebWolf button in WebGoat","- Move all lessons into `src/main/resources`","- WebGoat selects a port dynamically when starting. It will still start of port 8080 it will try another port to ease","  the user experience.","- WebGoat logs URL after startup: `Please browse to http://127.0.0.1:8080/WebGoat to get started...`","- Simplify `Dockerfile` as we no longer need a script to start everything","- Maven build now start WebGoat jar with Maven plugin to make sure we run against the latest build.","- Added `Initializable` interface for a lesson, an assignment can implement this interface to set it up for a specific","  user and to reset the assignment back to its original state when a reset lesson occurs. See `BlindSendFileAssignment`","  for an example.","- Integration tests now use the same user. This saves a lot of time as before every test used a different user which","  triggered the Flyway migration to set up the database schema for the user. This migration took a lot of time.","- Updated introduction lesson to WebWolf.","- Added language switch for support for multiple languages.","- Removed logic to start WebGoat on a random port when port `8080` is taken. We would loop until we found a free port.","  We simplified this to just start on the specified port.","- Add Google formatter for all our code, a PR now checks whether the code adheres to the standard.","- Renaming of all packages and folders.","- [#1039 New OWASP Top 10](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1093)","- [#1065 New lesson about logging](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1065)","","### Bug fixes","","- [#1193 Vulnerable component lesson - java.desktop does not \"opens java.beans\" to unnamed module](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1193)","- [#1176 Minor: XXE lesson 12 patch not reset by 'lesson reset' while it IS reset by leaving/returning to lesson](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1176)","- [#1134 \"Exploiting XStream\" assignment does not work](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1134)","- [#1130 Typo: Using Indrect References](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1130)","- [#1101 SQL lesson not correct](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1101)","- [#1079 startup.sh issues of WebWolf - cannot connect to the WebGoat DB](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1079)","- [#1379 Move XXE to A05:2021-_Security_ Misconfiguration](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1379)","- [#1298 SocketUtils is deprecated and will be removed in Spring Security 6](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1298)","- [#1248 Rewrite the WebWolf Introduction Lesson with the new changes](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1248)","- [#1200 Type cast error in sample code at JWT token section](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1200)","- [#1173 --server.port=9000 is not respected on Windows (both cmd as Powershell)](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1173)","- [#1103 (A1) path traversel lesson 7 seems broken](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1103)","- [#986 - User registration not persistant](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/986)","","## Version 8.2.2","","### New functionality","","- Docker image now supports nginx when browsing to http://localhost a landing page is shown.","","### Bug fixes","","- [#1039 jwt-7-Code review](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1039)","- [#1031 SQL Injection (intro) 5: Data Control Language (DCL) the wiki's solution is not correct](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1031)","- [#1027 Webgoat 8.2.1 Vulnerable_Components_12 Shows internal server error](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1027)","","## Version 8.2.1","","### New functionality","","- New Docker image for arm64 architecture is now available (for Apple M1)","","## Version 8.2.0","","### New functionality","","- Add new zip slip lesson (part of path traversal)","- SQL lessons are now separate for each user, database are now per user and no longer shared across users","- Moved to Java 15 \u0026 Spring Boot 2.4 \u0026 moved to JUnit 5","","### Bug fixes","","- [#974 SQL injection Intro 5 not solvable](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/974)","- [#962 SQL-Lesson 5 (Advanced) Solvable with wrong anwser](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/962)","- [#961 SQl-Injection lesson 4 not deleting created row](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/961)","- [#949 Challenge: Admin password reset always solvable](https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/949)","- [#923 - <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Version 2023.3</h2><a id="user-content-version-20233" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Version 2023.3" href="#version-20233"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">With great pleasure, we present you with a new release of WebGoat <strong>2023.3</strong>. Finally, it has been a while. This year
starts with a new release of WebGoat. This year we will undoubtedly release more often. From this release on, we began
to use a new versioning scheme (<a href="https://calver.org/#scheme" rel="nofollow">https://calver.org/#scheme</a>).</p>
<p dir="auto">A big thanks to René Zubcevic and Àngel Ollé Blázquez for keeping the project alive this last year, and hopefully, we
can make
many more releases this year.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">New functionality</h3><a id="user-content-new-functionality-2" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: New functionality" href="#new-functionality-2"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>New year's resolution(2022): major refactoring of WebGoat to simplify the setup and improve building times.</li>
<li>Move away from multi-project setup:
<ul dir="auto">
<li>This has a huge performance benefit when building the application. Build time locally is now
<code>Total time:  42.469 s</code> (depends on your local machine of course)</li>
<li>No longer add Maven dependencies in several places</li>
<li>H2 no longer needs to run as separate process, which solves the issue of WebWolf sharing and needing to configure
the correct database connection.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>More explicit paths in html files to reference <code>adoc</code> files, less magic.</li>
<li>Integrate WebWolf in WebGoat, the setup was way too complicated and needed configuration which could lead to mistakes
and a not working application. This also simplifies the Docker configuration as there is only 1 Docker image.</li>
<li>Add WebWolf button in WebGoat</li>
<li>Move all lessons into <code>src/main/resources</code></li>
<li>WebGoat selects a port dynamically when starting. It will still start of port 8080 it will try another port to ease
the user experience.</li>
<li>WebGoat logs URL after startup: <code>Please browse to http://127.0.0.1:8080/WebGoat to get started...</code></li>
<li>Simplify <code>Dockerfile</code> as we no longer need a script to start everything</li>
<li>Maven build now start WebGoat jar with Maven plugin to make sure we run against the latest build.</li>
<li>Added <code>Initializable</code> interface for a lesson, an assignment can implement this interface to set it up for a specific
user and to reset the assignment back to its original state when a reset lesson occurs. See <code>BlindSendFileAssignment</code>
for an example.</li>
<li>Integration tests now use the same user. This saves a lot of time as before every test used a different user which
triggered the Flyway migration to set up the database schema for the user. This migration took a lot of time.</li>
<li>Updated introduction lesson to WebWolf.</li>
<li>Added language switch for support for multiple languages.</li>
<li>Removed logic to start WebGoat on a random port when port <code>8080</code> is taken. We would loop until we found a free port.
We simplified this to just start on the specified port.</li>
<li>Add Google formatter for all our code, a PR now checks whether the code adheres to the standard.</li>
<li>Renaming of all packages and folders.</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1093" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1093/hovercard">#1039 New OWASP Top 10</a></li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1065" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/WebGoat/WebGoat/issues/1065/hovercard">#1065 New lesson about logging</a></li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">New functionality</h3><a id="user-content-new-functionality-6" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: New functionality" href="#new-functionality-6"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Added new lessons for cryptography and path-traversal</li>
<li>Extra content added to the XXE lesson</li>
<li>Explanation of the assignments will be part of WebGoat, in this release we added detailed descriptions on how to solve
the XXE lesson. In the upcoming releases new explanations will be added. If you want to contribute please create a
pull request on Github.</li>
<li>Docker improvements + docker stack for complete container with nginx</li>
<li>Included JWT token decoding and generation, since jwt.io does not support None anymore</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Bug fixes</h3><a id="user-content-bug-fixes-5" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Bug fixes" href="#bug-fixes-5"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

maintained by \u003ca href=\"http://www.owasp.org/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eOWASP\u003c/a\u003e designed to teach web\napplication security lessons.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThis program is a demonstration of common server-side application flaws. The\nexercises are intended to be used by people to learn about application security and\npenetration testing techniques.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eWARNING 1:\u003c/strong\u003e \u003cem\u003eWhile running this program your machine will be extremely\nvulnerable to attack. You should disconnect from the Internet while using\nthis program.\u003c/em\u003e  WebGoat's default configuration binds to localhost to minimize\nthe exposure.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eWARNING 2:\u003c/strong\u003e \u003cem\u003eThis program is for educational purposes only. If you attempt\nthese techniques without authorization, you are very likely to get caught. If\nyou are caught engaging in unauthorized hacking, most companies will fire you.\nClaiming that you were doing security research will not work as that is the\nfirst thing that all hackers claim.\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ca target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" href=\"/WebGoat/WebGoat/blob/main/docs/images/webgoat.png\"\u003e\u003cimg src=\"/WebGoat/WebGoat/raw/main/docs/images/webgoat.png\" alt=\"WebGoat\" style=\"max-width: 100%;\"\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch1 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eInstallation instructions:\u003c/h1\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-installation-instructions\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Installation instructions:\" href=\"#installation-instructions\"\u003e\u003csvg class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eFor more details check \u003ca href=\"/WebGoat/WebGoat/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md\"\u003ethe Contribution guide\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e1. Run using Docker\" href=\"#1-run-using-docker\"\u003e\u003csvg class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eAlready have a browser and ZAP and/or Burp installed on your machine in this case you can run the WebGoat image directly using Docker.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eEvery release is also published on \u003ca href=\"https://hub.docker.com/r/webgoat/webgoat\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eDockerHub\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 webgoat/webgoat\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003edocker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 webgoat/webgoat\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eFor some lessons you need the container run in the same timezone. For this you can set the TZ environment variable.\nE.g.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003edocker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eIf you want to use OWASP ZAP or another proxy, you can no longer use 127.0.0.1 or localhost. but\nyou can use custom host entries. For example:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"127.0.0.1 www.webgoat.local www.webwolf.local\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003e127.0.0.1 www.webgoat.local www.webwolf.local\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThen you can run the container with:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e WEBGOAT_HOST=www.webgoat.local -e WEBWOLF_HOST=www.webwolf.local -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003edocker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e WEBGOAT_HOST=www.webgoat.local -e WEBWOLF_HOST=www.webwolf.local -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThen visit \u003ca href=\"http://www.webgoat.local:8080/WebGoat/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003ehttp://www.webgoat.local:8080/WebGoat/\u003c/a\u003e and \u003ca href=\"http://www.webwolf.local:9090/WebWolf/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003ehttp://www.webwolf.local:9090/WebWolf/\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e2. shell/window:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"git clone git@github.com:WebGoat/WebGoat.git\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003egit clone git@github.com:WebGoat/WebGoat.git\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eNow let's start by compiling the project.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"cd WebGoat\ngit checkout \u0026lt;\u0026lt;branch_name\u0026gt;\u0026gt;\n# On Linux/Mac:\n./mvnw clean install\n\n# On Windows:\n./mvnw.cmd clean install\n\n# Using docker or podman, you can than build the container locally\ndocker build -f Dockerfile . -t webgoat/webgoat\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-c1\"\u003ecd\u003c/span\u003e WebGoat\ngit checkout \u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-k\"\u003e\u0026lt;\u0026lt;\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-k\"\u003ebranch_name\u0026gt;\u0026gt;\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e# On Linux/Mac:\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e./mvnw clean install\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e# On Windows:\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e./mvnw.cmd clean install\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e# Using docker or podman, you can than build the container locally\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003edocker build -f Dockerfile . -t webgoat/webgoat\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eNow we are ready to run the project. WebGoat is using Spring Boot.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"# On Linux/Mac:\n./mvnw spring-boot:run\n# On Windows:\n./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run\n\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e#\u003c/span\u003e On Linux/Mac:\u003c/span\u003e\n./mvnw spring-boot:run\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e#\u003c/span\u003e On Windows:\u003c/span\u003e\n./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run\n\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e... you should be running WebGoat on \u003ca href=\"http://localhost:8080/WebGoat\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003ehttp://localhost:8080/WebGoat\u003c/a\u003e momentarily.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eNote: The above link will redirect you to login page if you are not logged in. LogIn/Create account to proceed.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eTo change the IP address add the following variable to the \u003ccode\u003eWebGoat/webgoat-container/src/main/resources/application.properties\u003c/code\u003e file:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"server.address=x.x.x.x\"\u003e\u003cpre class=\"notranslate\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003eserver.address=x.x.x.x\n\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e4. There is a way to set up WebGoat with a personalized menu. You can leave out some menu categories or individual lessons by setting certain environment variables.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eFor instance running as a jar on a Linux/macOS it will look like this:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"export TZ=Europe/Amsterdam # or your timezone\nexport EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=\u0026quot;CLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE\u0026quot;\nexport EXCLUDE_LESSONS=\u0026quot;SqlInjectionAdvanced,SqlInjectionMitigations\u0026quot;\njava -jar target/webgoat-2023.8-SNAPSHOT.jar\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-k\"\u003eexport\u003c/span\u003e TZ=Europe/Amsterdam \u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e#\u003c/span\u003e or your timezone\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-k\"\u003eexport\u003c/span\u003e EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003eCLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-k\"\u003eexport\u003c/span\u003e EXCLUDE_LESSONS=\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003eSqlInjectionAdvanced,SqlInjectionMitigations\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\njava -jar target/webgoat-2023.8-SNAPSHOT.jar\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eOr in a docker run it would (once this version is pushed into docker hub) look like this:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=\u0026quot;CLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE\u0026quot; <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Introduction</h1><a id="user-content-introduction" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Introduction" href="#introduction"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">WebGoat is a deliberately insecure web application maintained by <a href="http://www.owasp.org/" rel="nofollow">OWASP</a> designed to teach web
application security lessons.</p>
<p dir="auto">This program is a demonstration of common server-side application flaws. The
exercises are intended to be used by people to learn about application security and
penetration testing techniques.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>WARNING 1:</strong> <em>While running this program your machine will be extremely
vulnerable to attack. You should disconnect from the Internet while using
this program.</em>  WebGoat's default configuration binds to localhost to minimize
the exposure.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>WARNING 2:</strong> <em>This program is for educational purposes only. If you attempt
these techniques without authorization, you are very likely to get caught. If
you are caught engaging in unauthorized hacking, most companies will fire you.
Claiming that you were doing security research will not work as that is the
first thing that all hackers claim.</em></p>
<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="/WebGoat/WebGoat/blob/main/docs/images/webgoat.png"><img src="/WebGoat/WebGoat/raw/main/docs/images/webgoat.png" alt="WebGoat" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Installation instructions:</h1><a id="user-content-installation-instructions" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Installation instructions:" href="#installation-instructions"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">For more details check <a href="/WebGoat/WebGoat/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md">the Contribution guide</a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">1. Run using Docker</h2><a id="user-content-1-run-using-docker" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 1. Run using Docker" href="#1-run-using-docker"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Already have a browser and ZAP and/or Burp installed on your machine in this case you can run the WebGoat image directly using Docker.</p>
<p dir="auto">Every release is also published on <a href="https://hub.docker.com/r/webgoat/webgoat" rel="nofollow">DockerHub</a>.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 webgoat/webgoat"><pre>docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 webgoat/webgoat</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">For some lessons you need the container run in the same timezone. For this you can set the TZ environment variable.
E.g.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat"><pre>docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">If you want to use OWASP ZAP or another proxy, you can no longer use 127.0.0.1 or localhost. but
you can use custom host entries. For example:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="127.0.0.1 www.webgoat.local www.webwolf.local"><pre>127.0.0.1 www.webgoat.local www.webwolf.local</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Then you can run the container with:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e WEBGOAT_HOST=www.webgoat.local -e WEBWOLF_HOST=www.webwolf.local -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat"><pre>docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e WEBGOAT_HOST=www.webgoat.local -e WEBWOLF_HOST=www.webwolf.local -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Then visit <a href="http://www.webgoat.local:8080/WebGoat/" rel="nofollow">http://www.webgoat.local:8080/WebGoat/</a> and <a href="http://www.webwolf.local:9090/WebWolf/" rel="nofollow">http://www.webwolf.local:9090/WebWolf/</a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">2. Run using Docker with complete Linux Desktop</h2><a id="user-content-2-run-using-docker-with-complete-linux-desktop" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 2. Run using Docker with complete Linux Desktop" href="#2-run-using-docker-with-complete-linux-desktop"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Instead of installing tools locally we have a complete Docker image based on running a desktop in your browser. This way you only have to run a Docker image which will give you the best user experience.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 webgoat/webgoat-desktop"><pre>docker run -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 webgoat/webgoat-desktop</pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">3. Standalone</h2><a id="user-content-3-standalone" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 3. Standalone" href="#3-standalone"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Download the latest WebGoat release from <a href="https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/releases">https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/releases</a></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="export TZ=Europe/Amsterdam # or your timezone
java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar"><pre><span class="pl-k">export</span> TZ=Europe/Amsterdam <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> or your timezone</span>
java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Click the link in the log to start WebGoat.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">3.1 Running on a different port</h3><a id="user-content-31-running-on-a-different-port" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 3.1 Running on a different port" href="#31-running-on-a-different-port"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">If for some reason you want to run WebGoat on a different port, you can do so by adding the following parameter:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="java -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar --webgoat.port=8001 --webwolf.port=8002"><pre>java -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar --webgoat.port=8001 --webwolf.port=8002</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">For a full overview of all the parameters you can use, please check the [WebGoat properties file](webgoat-container/src/main/resources/application-{webgoat, webwolf}.properties).</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">4. Run from the sources</h2><a id="user-content-4-run-from-the-sources" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 4. Run from the sources" href="#4-run-from-the-sources"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Prerequisites:</h3><a id="user-content-prerequisites" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Prerequisites:" href="#prerequisites"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Java 25</li>
<li>Your favorite IDE</li>
<li>Git, or Git support in your IDE</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Open a command shell/window:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="git clone git@github.com:WebGoat/WebGoat.git"><pre>git clone git@github.com:WebGoat/WebGoat.git</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Now let's start by compiling the project.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="cd WebGoat
git checkout &lt;&lt;branch_name&gt;&gt;
# On Linux/Mac:
./mvnw clean install

# On Windows:
./mvnw.cmd clean install

# Using docker or podman, you can than build the container locally
docker build -f Dockerfile . -t webgoat/webgoat"><pre><span class="pl-c1">cd</span> WebGoat
git checkout <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-k">&lt;&lt;</span><span class="pl-k">branch_name&gt;&gt;</span></span>
<span class="pl-s"># On Linux/Mac:</span>
<span class="pl-s">./mvnw clean install</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s"># On Windows:</span>
<span class="pl-s">./mvnw.cmd clean install</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s"># Using docker or podman, you can than build the container locally</span>
<span class="pl-s">docker build -f Dockerfile . -t webgoat/webgoat</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Now we are ready to run the project. WebGoat is using Spring Boot.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="# On Linux/Mac:
./mvnw spring-boot:run
# On Windows:
./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> On Linux/Mac:</span>
./mvnw spring-boot:run
<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> On Windows:</span>
./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">... you should be running WebGoat on <a href="http://localhost:8080/WebGoat" rel="nofollow">http://localhost:8080/WebGoat</a> momentarily.</p>
<p dir="auto">Note: The above link will redirect you to login page if you are not logged in. LogIn/Create account to proceed.</p>
<p dir="auto">To change the IP address add the following variable to the <code>WebGoat/webgoat-container/src/main/resources/application.properties</code> file:</p>
<div class="snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="server.address=x.x.x.x"><pre class="notranslate"><code>server.address=x.x.x.x
</code></pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">4. Run with custom menu</h2><a id="user-content-4-run-with-custom-menu" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 4. Run with custom menu" href="#4-run-with-custom-menu"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">For specialist only. There is a way to set up WebGoat with a personalized menu. You can leave out some menu categories or individual lessons by setting certain environment variables.</p>
<p dir="auto">For instance running as a jar on a Linux/macOS it will look like this:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="export TZ=Europe/Amsterdam # or your timezone
export EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=&quot;CLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE&quot;
export EXCLUDE_LESSONS=&quot;SqlInjectionAdvanced,SqlInjectionMitigations&quot;
java -jar target/webgoat-2023.8-SNAPSHOT.jar"><pre><span class="pl-k">export</span> TZ=Europe/Amsterdam <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> or your timezone</span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>CLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> EXCLUDE_LESSONS=<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>SqlInjectionAdvanced,SqlInjectionMitigations<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
java -jar target/webgoat-2023.8-SNAPSHOT.jar</pre></div>

maintained by \u003ca href=\"http://www.owasp.org/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eOWASP\u003c/a\u003e designed to teach web\napplication security lessons.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThis program is a demonstration of common server-side application flaws. The\nexercises are intended to be used by people to learn about application security and\npenetration testing techniques.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eWARNING 1:\u003c/strong\u003e \u003cem\u003eWhile running this program your machine will be extremely\nvulnerable to attack. You should disconnect from the Internet while using\nthis program.\u003c/em\u003e  WebGoat's default configuration binds to localhost to minimize\nthe exposure.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eWARNING 2:\u003c/strong\u003e \u003cem\u003eThis program is for educational purposes only. If you attempt\nthese techniques without authorization, you are very likely to get caught. If\nyou are caught engaging in unauthorized hacking, most companies will fire you.\nClaiming that you were doing security research will not work as that is the\nfirst thing that all hackers claim.\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ca target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" href=\"/WebGoat/WebGoat/blob/main/docs/images/webgoat.png\"\u003e\u003cimg src=\"/WebGoat/WebGoat/raw/main/docs/images/webgoat.png\" alt=\"WebGoat\" style=\"max-width: 100%;\"\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch1 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eInstallation instructions:\u003c/h1\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-installation-instructions\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Installation instructions:\" href=\"#installation-instructions\"\u003e\u003csvg class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eFor more details check \u003ca href=\"/WebGoat/WebGoat/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md\"\u003ethe Contribution guide\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e1. Run using Docker\" href=\"#1-run-using-docker\"\u003e\u003csvg class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eAlready have a browser and ZAP and/or Burp installed on your machine in this case you can run the WebGoat image directly using Docker.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eEvery release is also published on \u003ca href=\"https://hub.docker.com/r/webgoat/webgoat\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eDockerHub\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 webgoat/webgoat\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003edocker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 webgoat/webgoat\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eFor some lessons you need the container run in the same timezone. For this you can set the TZ environment variable.\nE.g.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003edocker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eIf you want to use OWASP ZAP or another proxy, you can no longer use 127.0.0.1 or localhost. but\nyou can use custom host entries. For example:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"127.0.0.1 www.webgoat.local www.webwolf.local\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003e127.0.0.1 www.webgoat.local www.webwolf.local\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThen you can run the container with:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e WEBGOAT_HOST=www.webgoat.local -e WEBWOLF_HOST=www.webwolf.local -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003edocker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e WEBGOAT_HOST=www.webgoat.local -e WEBWOLF_HOST=www.webwolf.local -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThen visit \u003ca href=\"http://www.webgoat.local:8080/WebGoat/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003ehttp://www.webgoat.local:8080/WebGoat/\u003c/a\u003e and \u003ca href=\"http://www.webwolf.local:9090/WebWolf/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003ehttp://www.webwolf.local:9090/WebWolf/\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e2.
