shell/window:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"git clone git@github.com:WebGoat/WebGoat.git\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003egit clone git@github.com:WebGoat/WebGoat.git\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eNow let's start by compiling the project.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"cd WebGoat\ngit checkout \u0026lt;\u0026lt;branch_name\u0026gt;\u0026gt;\n# On Linux/Mac:\n./mvnw clean install\n\n# On Windows:\n./mvnw.cmd clean install\n\n# Using docker or podman, you can than build the container locally\ndocker build -f Dockerfile . -t webgoat/webgoat\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-c1\"\u003ecd\u003c/span\u003e WebGoat\ngit checkout \u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-k\"\u003e\u0026lt;\u0026lt;\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-k\"\u003ebranch_name\u0026gt;\u0026gt;\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e# On Linux/Mac:\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e./mvnw clean install\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e# On Windows:\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e./mvnw.cmd clean install\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e# Using docker or podman, you can than build the container locally\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003edocker build -f Dockerfile . -t webgoat/webgoat\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eNow we are ready to run the project. WebGoat is using Spring Boot.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"# On Linux/Mac:\n./mvnw spring-boot:run\n# On Windows:\n./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run\n\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e#\u003c/span\u003e On Linux/Mac:\u003c/span\u003e\n./mvnw spring-boot:run\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e#\u003c/span\u003e On Windows:\u003c/span\u003e\n./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run\n\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e... you should be running WebGoat on \u003ca href=\"http://localhost:8080/WebGoat\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003ehttp://localhost:8080/WebGoat\u003c/a\u003e momentarily.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eNote: The above link will redirect you to login page if you are not logged in. LogIn/Create account to proceed.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eTo change the IP address add the following variable to the \u003ccode\u003eWebGoat/webgoat-container/src/main/resources/application.properties\u003c/code\u003e file:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"server.address=x.x.x.x\"\u003e\u003cpre class=\"notranslate\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003eserver.address=x.x.x.x\n\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch2 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e4. There is a way to set up WebGoat with a personalized menu. You can leave out some menu categories or individual lessons by setting certain environment variables.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eFor instance running as a jar on a Linux/macOS it will look like this:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"export TZ=Europe/Amsterdam # or your timezone\nexport EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=\u0026quot;CLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE\u0026quot;\nexport EXCLUDE_LESSONS=\u0026quot;SqlInjectionAdvanced,SqlInjectionMitigations\u0026quot;\njava -jar target/webgoat-2023.8-SNAPSHOT.jar\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-k\"\u003eexport\u003c/span\u003e TZ=Europe/Amsterdam \u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-c\"\u003e#\u003c/span\u003e or your timezone\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-k\"\u003eexport\u003c/span\u003e EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003eCLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-k\"\u003eexport\u003c/span\u003e EXCLUDE_LESSONS=\u003cspan class=\"pl-s\"\u003e\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003eSqlInjectionAdvanced,SqlInjectionMitigations\u003cspan class=\"pl-pds\"\u003e\"\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/span\u003e\njava -jar target/webgoat-2023.8-SNAPSHOT.jar\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eOr in a docker run it would (once this version is pushed into docker hub) look like this:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=\u0026quot;CLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE\u0026quot; <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Introduction</h1><a id="user-content-introduction" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Introduction" href="#introduction"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">WebGoat is a deliberately insecure web application maintained by <a href="http://www.owasp.org/" rel="nofollow">OWASP</a> designed to teach web
application security lessons.</p>
<p dir="auto">This program is a demonstration of common server-side application flaws. The
exercises are intended to be used by people to learn about application security and
penetration testing techniques.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>WARNING 1:</strong> <em>While running this program your machine will be extremely
vulnerable to attack. You should disconnect from the Internet while using
this program.</em>  WebGoat's default configuration binds to localhost to minimize
the exposure.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>WARNING 2:</strong> <em>This program is for educational purposes only. If you attempt
these techniques without authorization, you are very likely to get caught. If
you are caught engaging in unauthorized hacking, most companies will fire you.
Claiming that you were doing security research will not work as that is the
first thing that all hackers claim.</em></p>
<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="/WebGoat/WebGoat/blob/main/docs/images/webgoat.png"><img src="/WebGoat/WebGoat/raw/main/docs/images/webgoat.png" alt="WebGoat" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Installation instructions:</h1><a id="user-content-installation-instructions" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Installation instructions:" href="#installation-instructions"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">For more details check <a href="/WebGoat/WebGoat/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md">the Contribution guide</a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">1. Run using Docker</h2><a id="user-content-1-run-using-docker" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 1. Run using Docker" href="#1-run-using-docker"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Already have a browser and ZAP and/or Burp installed on your machine in this case you can run the WebGoat image directly using Docker.</p>
<p dir="auto">Every release is also published on <a href="https://hub.docker.com/r/webgoat/webgoat" rel="nofollow">DockerHub</a>.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 webgoat/webgoat"><pre>docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 webgoat/webgoat</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">For some lessons you need the container run in the same timezone. For this you can set the TZ environment variable.
E.g.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat"><pre>docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">If you want to use OWASP ZAP or another proxy, you can no longer use 127.0.0.1 or localhost. but
you can use custom host entries. For example:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="127.0.0.1 www.webgoat.local www.webwolf.local"><pre>127.0.0.1 www.webgoat.local www.webwolf.local</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Then you can run the container with:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e WEBGOAT_HOST=www.webgoat.local -e WEBWOLF_HOST=www.webwolf.local -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat"><pre>docker run -it -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -p 127.0.0.1:9090:9090 -e WEBGOAT_HOST=www.webgoat.local -e WEBWOLF_HOST=www.webwolf.local -e TZ=America/Boise webgoat/webgoat</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Then visit <a href="http://www.webgoat.local:8080/WebGoat/" rel="nofollow">http://www.webgoat.local:8080/WebGoat/</a> and <a href="http://www.webwolf.local:9090/WebWolf/" rel="nofollow">http://www.webwolf.local:9090/WebWolf/</a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">2. Run using Docker with complete Linux Desktop</h2><a id="user-content-2-run-using-docker-with-complete-linux-desktop" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 2. Run using Docker with complete Linux Desktop" href="#2-run-using-docker-with-complete-linux-desktop"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Instead of installing tools locally we have a complete Docker image based on running a desktop in your browser. This way you only have to run a Docker image which will give you the best user experience.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker run -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 webgoat/webgoat-desktop"><pre>docker run -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 webgoat/webgoat-desktop</pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">3. Standalone</h2><a id="user-content-3-standalone" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 3. Standalone" href="#3-standalone"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Download the latest WebGoat release from <a href="https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/releases">https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat/releases</a></p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="export TZ=Europe/Amsterdam # or your timezone
java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar"><pre><span class="pl-k">export</span> TZ=Europe/Amsterdam <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> or your timezone</span>
java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Click the link in the log to start WebGoat.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">3.1 Running on a different port</h3><a id="user-content-31-running-on-a-different-port" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 3.1 Running on a different port" href="#31-running-on-a-different-port"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">If for some reason you want to run WebGoat on a different port, you can do so by adding the following parameter:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="java -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar --webgoat.port=8001 --webwolf.port=8002"><pre>java -jar webgoat-2023.8.jar --webgoat.port=8001 --webwolf.port=8002</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">For a full overview of all the parameters you can use, please check the [WebGoat properties file](webgoat-container/src/main/resources/application-{webgoat, webwolf}.properties).</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">4. Run from the sources</h2><a id="user-content-4-run-from-the-sources" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 4. Run from the sources" href="#4-run-from-the-sources"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Prerequisites:</h3><a id="user-content-prerequisites" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Prerequisites:" href="#prerequisites"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Java 25</li>
<li>Your favorite IDE</li>
<li>Git, or Git support in your IDE</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Open a command shell/window:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="git clone git@github.com:WebGoat/WebGoat.git"><pre>git clone git@github.com:WebGoat/WebGoat.git</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Now let's start by compiling the project.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="cd WebGoat
git checkout &lt;&lt;branch_name&gt;&gt;
# On Linux/Mac:
./mvnw clean install

# On Windows:
./mvnw.cmd clean install

# Using docker or podman, you can than build the container locally
docker build -f Dockerfile . -t webgoat/webgoat"><pre><span class="pl-c1">cd</span> WebGoat
git checkout <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-k">&lt;&lt;</span><span class="pl-k">branch_name&gt;&gt;</span></span>
<span class="pl-s"># On Linux/Mac:</span>
<span class="pl-s">./mvnw clean install</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s"># On Windows:</span>
<span class="pl-s">./mvnw.cmd clean install</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s"># Using docker or podman, you can than build the container locally</span>
<span class="pl-s">docker build -f Dockerfile . -t webgoat/webgoat</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Now we are ready to run the project. WebGoat is using Spring Boot.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="# On Linux/Mac:
./mvnw spring-boot:run
# On Windows:
./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> On Linux/Mac:</span>
./mvnw spring-boot:run
<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> On Windows:</span>
./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">... you should be running WebGoat on <a href="http://localhost:8080/WebGoat" rel="nofollow">http://localhost:8080/WebGoat</a> momentarily.</p>
<p dir="auto">Note: The above link will redirect you to login page if you are not logged in. LogIn/Create account to proceed.</p>
<p dir="auto">To change the IP address add the following variable to the <code>WebGoat/webgoat-container/src/main/resources/application.properties</code> file:</p>
<div class="snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="server.address=x.x.x.x"><pre class="notranslate"><code>server.address=x.x.x.x
</code></pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">4. Run with custom menu</h2><a id="user-content-4-run-with-custom-menu" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 4. Run with custom menu" href="#4-run-with-custom-menu"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">For specialist only. There is a way to set up WebGoat with a personalized menu. You can leave out some menu categories or individual lessons by setting certain environment variables.</p>
<p dir="auto">For instance running as a jar on a Linux/macOS it will look like this:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="export TZ=Europe/Amsterdam # or your timezone
export EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=&quot;CLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE&quot;
export EXCLUDE_LESSONS=&quot;SqlInjectionAdvanced,SqlInjectionMitigations&quot;
java -jar target/webgoat-2023.8-SNAPSHOT.jar"><pre><span class="pl-k">export</span> TZ=Europe/Amsterdam <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> or your timezone</span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> EXCLUDE_CATEGORIES=<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>CLIENT_SIDE,GENERAL,CHALLENGE<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> EXCLUDE_LESSONS=<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>SqlInjectionAdvanced,SqlInjectionMitigations<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
java -jar target/webgoat-2023.8-SNAPSHOT.jar</pre></div>
